verdicts.reason: A keeps the can large as the hero and the 30% OFF → CTA hierarchy is clear. Its flaws: the right text column is cramped against the edge, the legal text is oversized (four lines, almost as big as the subhead), the logo is tiny and off to one side, and SUNSET SALE now sits below the headline instead of above it. B has a strong centred headline, but the product is shrunk to a small can stuck in the left gap opposite the CTA. That leaves the middle row looking arbitrary and lopsided, SUNSET SALE is so big it competes with the headline, and the legal text runs into the corner circle.
